# Inner Animal — handoff

**Deploy:** commit first (own Bash call), then `railway up --ci --service inner-animal` (the project has more than one service, so `--service` is required), then `git push`. Tests: `npm test`.
**Gotchas:** `docs/architecture/*` is generated by another tool; never stage it. A `codex/verified-checkpoint-20260911` branch exists but only touches `docs/architecture/`.
